How the War Turned Sudan Into a Country Without a Newspaper

A war of narratives is being waged within the war in Sudan. The warring parties—the official Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), a paramilitary force—are fighting an information war through traditional and social media. Misinformation, disinformation, hate speech, and propaganda are routinely deployed, and Sudanese journalists have become targets. Thirty-four journalists have been killed in Sudan in the past three and a half years of war…
